units.source_text: 这天刮西南风，风势墓地猛烈起来，又冥然而止。

en.t: That day a southwest wind was blowing; it suddenly grew fierce, then died away into a dark silence.

units.source_text: 飘来了阵阵不安的微风。

en.t: Uneasy little gusts drifted in one after another.

units.source_text: 天空虽然昏暗，还不至于完全不知道太阳的在处。

en.t: Although the sky was dim, it was not so dark that one could no longer tell where the sun was.

units.source_text: 一部分浮云透出了白光，有如在裹着多层衣服的领口处隐约可见白色的胸脯。

en.t: White light shone through part of the floating clouds, like a pale breast faintly visible at the collar of someone wrapped in many layers of clothing.

units.source_text: 诚然，白光是朦朦胧胧，人们都知道太阳躲藏在其朦胧的深处，而它却又立即融化在明天一样的深灰色中。

en.t: True, the white light was hazy and indistinct; everyone knew the sun was hidden deep within that haze, yet it immediately melted back into a dark gray like the sky of tomorrow.
